output.recommendation: Establish a Cyber Crisis Management Authority (CCMA) with clear lead responsibilities for AI-driven telecom network emergencies, ensuring it can coordinate with existing regulatory bodies and crisis management authorities. This CCMA should be designated in advance as per [G1] EU-NIS2-2022 Article 1(2)(a).
output.rationale: This recommendation ensures a dedicated authority is responsible for AI-driven telecom network emergencies, preventing lead claims collisions or leadership voids by aligning with the established practice of designating competent authorities and cyber crisis management bodies in advance.
